#include <assert.h>

#include <stdio.h>

    HTMAlefHandle result = htm_convert("<table><thead><tr><th colspan=\"2\">Full Name</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>John</td><td>Doe</td></tr></tbody></table>", 0);
